content.title: Has the Market Fully Priced Oceaneering’s Offshore Growth Story After Its Big Multi Year Run?
content.summary: Wondering if Oceaneering International at around $24.84 is still a deal or if the easy money has been made? You are not the only one sizing up whether the current price matches its long term potential. The stock has been choppy in the short term, down 3.9% over the last week and up 2.9% over the last month, but those swings sit on top of a 47.8% gain over 3 years and a 211.7% gain over 5 years. Recent market interest has been driven less by flashy headlines and more by a steady narrative...

content.title: Eni and BlackRock's Global Infrastructure Partners Finalize CCS Deal
content.summary: E finalizes the sale of a 49.99% stake of its CCS unit to BlackRock's GIP, securing approvals and adding a co-investor to strengthen its carbon capture strategy.

content.title: 3 Oilfield Services Stocks Set to Gain From Solid Industry Prospects
content.summary: Low reliance on debt should enable oilfield service companies to access capital on favorable terms in a volatile business environment, underpinning a promising outlook for the Zacks Oil and Gas- Field Services industry. HAL, BKR and OII are thus well poised to gain.

content.title: Petrobras and Braskem Seal $17.8B Deals for Feedstock Supply
content.summary: Petrobras inks $17.8B long-term feedstock deals, ending years of talks and reshaping Brazil's petrochemical supply chain.

content.title: Chevron Keeps Venezuelan Oil Flowing Despite Rising U.S. Pressure
content.summary: CVX keeps exporting Venezuelan crude under a U.S. license, loading 1M barrels despite sanctions, a naval blockade, and falling national output.

content.title: New Strong Buy Stocks for December 22nd
content.summary: OII, PJT, MODG, OPFI and VIST have been added to the Zacks Rank #1 (Strong Buy) List on Dec. 22, 2025

content.title: Equinor Taps Deepsea Aberdeen for Drilling Operations Offshore Norway
content.summary: EQNR awards Odfjell Drilling a multi-year contract for the Deepsea Aberdeen drillship to carry out offshore projects on the NCS.

content.title: TechnipFMC Partners with Eni on Coral North FLNG Project
content.summary: FTI wins a $250-$500 million EPCI deal for Eni's Coral North FLNG project offshore Mozambique, reinforcing its leadership in ultra-deepwater subsea.

content.title: Shell Approves Waterflood Project at Kaikias Field in the US Gulf
content.summary: SHEL approves a waterflood project at the Kaikias field to lift recoverable resources and extend the Ursa platform's productive life in the Gulf of America.

content.title: Are Investors Undervaluing Oceaneering International (OII) Right Now?
content.summary: Here at Zacks, our focus is on the proven Zacks Rank system, which emphasizes earnings estimates and estimate revisions to find great stocks. Nevertheless, we are always paying attention to the latest value, growth, and momentum trends to underscore strong picks.
